open.1.text: The fire has burned since the day everything stopped. No one remembers who lit it.

open.2.text: Carry it carefully. It is all the time that is left.

gate.firstLit.text: He is still reaching for the lever. He has been reaching for four thousand years.

gate.replayEnds.text: The light moves on. So does he, back into the wall.

gate.stepIn.text: Do what he did. Only what he did.

gate.opens.text: The city lets you in. It is not sure why.

gate.wrongSeen.text: That one was not here before.

market.enter.text: They were haggling when it happened. Listen. You can almost hear it.

market.bridge.text: A poor man's shadow, carrying you. He would have liked that.

market.collapse.text: Run. The city remembers how to fall.

market.brazier.text: Rest. The fire needs it more than you.

temple.enter.text: They prayed for more time. They were given exactly this.

temple.priest.text: One begged. One ran. One only waited.

temple.vault.text: The hours were never lost. Only held.

temple.nearFalse.text: The flame looks warm. Look closer.

library.enter.text: They wrote it down so no one would forget. Then everyone forgot to read.

library.above.text: There it is. Plainly. Someone lit this fire on purpose.

library.face.text: You have seen that face before. In every still water.

heart.enter.text: Every shadow in the city is looking at you. Not at the fire. At you.

heart.fifth.text: The last angle is the one you cast yourself.

heart.rumble.text: Do you hear it? It has been waiting a very long time.

death.1.text: The flame returns to the wall. The wall remembers you now.

death.3.text: You are not the first to try.

death.4.text: You are the first to try this long.

wrong.notYet.text: Not yet. Not yet. Not yet.

wrong.face.text: You have always known my face.

wrong.kinder.text: It is kinder to look away.

wrong.knows.text: I know where it goes. I have always known.

wrong.door.text: Hold the door. Please. Just a little longer.

hint.stuck.1.text: Something here is waiting to be seen.

hint.stuck.2.text: Turn the light. Slowly. Let it tell you.

hint.stuck.3.text: Watch. I will show you once.

hint.failed.2.text: Lower me. Or higher. Feel where I want to go.

hint.failed.3.text: There. That angle. Hold me there.

hint.ash.1.text: I am running thin. We should rest.

hint.ash.2.text: There is a brazier ahead. I can feel its warmth.

hint.ash.3.text: Follow the embers. They lead home.

hint.caught.1.text: Cold air. Something is behind us.

hint.caught.2.text: It moves when you stop looking. Look back.

hint.caught.3.text: There. That is where it stands.

hint.word.2.text: Closer. Do you hear it humming?

hint.word.3.text: Right there. In the corner. A last word.

hint.riddle.2.text: The answer is in the words, not the wall.

hint.riddle.3.text: The answer is what follows you.

pz.gate.1.text: The guard faces away from where the light should fall. Try the other side.

pz.gate.2.text: He reaches for something behind the pillar.

pz.market.1.text: A low sun makes long shadows. Remember that.

pz.market.2.text: The scale only needs a smaller shadow on one side.

pz.temple.1.text: The priests did not die together. Who was first?

pz.temple.2.text: One of them is not praying. He is only looking up.

pz.library.1.text: Read from the side, it lies. Try from above.

pz.heart.1.text: Four plates, four lessons. The fifth is missing, and it is closer than you think.

pz.heart.2.text: Hold me close. Let your own shadow fall.

end.keep.1.text: The fire settles. The city goes quiet again.

end.keep.2.text: Safe. Whole. Still. This is a kind of mercy.

end.keep.3.text: Somewhere, a shadow reaches for a door, and does not reach it.

end.letGo.1.text: The dark arrives. Then, for the first time in four thousand years, footsteps.

end.letGo.2.text: They are alive. They are looking at you. They are smiling.

end.letGo.3.text: Then the sound of water. It does not stop.

end.door.1.text: They heard you. Every last word, all of them, at once.

end.door.2.text: For one second the city moves, and one second is enough.

end.door.3.text: The door holds. The shadow holds it. It knew it would.

end.door.4.text: The fire has burned for four thousand years. Now it can finally go out.

end.carry.2.text: You lit this. You have been lighting it for four thousand years.

end.carry.3.text: Carry it out. A held breath has to be held somewhere.

end.carry.4.text: Past the walls, an old hearth is waiting. And the sun is waiting with it.

word.1.text: Tell my wife the gate is open.

word.2.text: Did you hear that? Like rain, but under the floor.

word.3.text: I only wanted to see the market.

word.4.text: Close it behind us. Close it now.

word.5.text: I have never once been late.

word.7.text: A coin for the road. Or for the river.

word.8.text: The bread will be warm. Wait for me.

word.10.text: A fair weight. I swear it on my name.

word.11.text: Count it twice. Count it again.

word.12.text: The wells are rising. Has anyone noticed?

word.13.text: There is still time. There is always time.

word.14.text: Run. Leave the bells, leave everything.

word.15.text: Give us one more hour. Just one.

word.16.text: The light is changing. Something is lighting the sky.

word.17.text: I rang it as loud as I could.

word.18.text: Who is that, standing in the doorway?

word.19.text: If someone lights a fire, let it burn.

word.20.text: I wrote it all down, in case we forgot.

word.21.text: The east stair is the only way up.

word.22.text: We were warned. We thought it was a story.

word.23.text: Take the book. Leave me the lamp.

word.24.text: The water comes from the west. Draw it.

word.25.text: Someone will read this, one day.

word.26.text: Is that you? Why do you look so tired?

word.27.text: Hold my hand. Don't let go this time.

word.29.text: We were saved once, before. By someone stubborn.

word.30.text: Stay with me. Just one more song.

word.31.text: Look. The fire is the same shape as you.

word.32.text: I built the stairs. Nobody ever used them.

word.34.text: He said a river was coming. Nobody listened.

word.35.text: The hour is one second long. Use it.

word.36.text: I lit it. Forgive me. I would do it again.

riddle.gate.text: What follows the light, yet leads the way?

riddle.market.text: The poor man's shadow is longer at dusk than the king's at noon.

riddle.temple.text: One hour wasted, one feared, one begged for, one never seen.

riddle.library.text: Read me from the side and I'm a lie, from above and I'm the end.

riddle.heart.text: I am the one who is missing, and the one who stayed.

hint.riddle.3.market.text: A low flame. Dusk stretches any shadow past noon.

hint.riddle.3.library.text: Hold me directly above each page.
